# E0108: a version file declares no schema

Every version file declares a schema; that is what a version is. A file with
only lenses has nothing for them to map to.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		a: v0_0.a
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue

```

thema reports:

```
error[E0108]: history/1.0.thema declares no Schema
 --> ship/history/1.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: every version file declares Schema: {...}
```
